lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines observed on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively equidistant in the central mass, with increased density and narrower intervals observed as the lines approach the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 4th line (counting from posterior), which splits into a narrow Y-shape at the ventral terminus.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (posterior) is a short segment terminating 1/3 of the way down the flank. Line 6 and Line 11 exhibit mid-torso termination points, failing to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 3 distinct white spots located on the lower posterior haunch above the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Linear spike morphology emerging at approximately 35 degrees relative to the cranial plane; no lyrate or spiral curvature present in this juvenile/sub-adult specimen.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated apical tip distance to base width ratio of 1.3:1.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron mark between the ocular regions; two distinct white spots on the muzzle; dark brown dorsal mane extending from the nape to the rump.
